messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — we need a decision on rollback thresholds + milestone latches for the MVP launch. Customer pilot wants a hard freeze on feature X after canary; eng prefers a soft latch to avoid blocking patches. Main constraints: allow safe rollback to v0.9 without data loss, but avoid unnecessary timeline resets. Thoughts?
Alex (Eng): Proposal: automatic rollback if error rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency regresses > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes. Soft latch: pause rollout for 24h instead of full timeline reset.
Maria (Design): Clarify "pause rollout" UX — do we surface a banner to pilot customers? If we pause, users should see degraded mode clearly.
Dave (Infra): Canary config we used last week looks fine. Example flagging command we run in staging: ```./redwood rollout --model mvp-v1 --canary 5% --health-checks error_rate:3%,p95:2x --auto-rollback true``` We can add a "hold" tag that prevents DB-affecting rollbacks.
Priya (PM): Important callout: some pilot customers use SSO + token migration. That means DB migrations are effectively irreversible for that customer — we cannot allow schema rollbacks. So rule: no DB/schema rollbacks without explicit customer opt-out and manual runbook.
Alex (Eng): Agreed. So: 1) automatic code rollback allowed for stateless changes per health rules. 2) migrations get a "migration window" and are gated by a feature-toggle; once migration runs for a customer, rollback is disallowed and we must ship a forward fix.
Maria (Design): OK — for UX, we'll add an in-app banner for pilot customers that says "You're on a pilot build. If we pause the rollout you'll stay on current experience while we investigate." Short copy ready, will drop into PR.
Priya (PM): Milestone latch proposal: if an invited pilot customer is active on the milestone, timeline cannot be reset unless the incident meets Severity 1 AND both PM + CTO sign off. That prevents knee-jerk resets for minor flakiness.
Alex (Eng): Operationally reasonable. Also recommend a "fast-unlatch" path: ops can lift the latch after a post-mortem and a remediation patch verified in staging.
Dave (Infra): deploy-bot: Canary started for mvp-v1 -> canary=5% at 2026-03-23T14:12:30Z. Health checks enabled.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary health passing at 2m.
Priya (PM): Action items: - Alex: write health-rule config + add migration-window gating doc (owner: Alex) - Dave: add hold-tag to rollout tool and document steps (owner: Dave) - Maria: prepare pilot banner copy and placement (owner: Maria) - Priya: draft milestone-latch policy and approval flow and circulate to execs (owner: Priya). Target: decision + docs by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
Alex (Eng): Ack, will push config PR today.
Dave (Infra): Will add hold-tag and update runbook.
Maria (Design): Banner copy into PR by EOD.
Priya (PM): Thanks — if anyone has objections to the severity+PM+CTO approval gate, call it out now, otherwise I'll lock this as policy and roll into the launch checklist.
